nodes.title: Graphiti Fractal — FM-17-pre Structural Oracle Ablation
nodes.summary: Pre-execution targeted mechanistic ablation package asking whether oracle-quality query+fact structure adds qualification value beyond CE ranking on frozen FM-16 run_007 inputs. Protocol/schema gate frozen; annotation and ablation not executed.
nodes.why_read: Open as the current post-FM-16 bounded research frontier. It measures a structural-information ceiling before investing in extraction, LLM/SLM recognition, graph/path scoring, or runtime design.

research.research_question: Does oracle-quality typed query-and-fact structure add useful qualification signal beyond CE-only ranking, and does structural→CE residual preserve more useful evidence than structure alone?
research.origin_problem: FM-16 showed useful CE ranking signal but no feasible single global raw threshold under mixed-query constraints, leaving the residual qualification error class open.
prior_evidence: FM-16 run_007 frozen artifacts and reconciled closure.
Scope discrimination remained partial and broad/no-answer score regimes overlapped.
competing_hypotheses: Typed structural information may remove a meaningful part of the residual error class.
Structure alone may be too lossy, while structural→CE residual may preserve useful semantic evidence.
The residual may remain largely unresolved even with oracle structure.
experiments: FM-17-pre targeted mechanistic ablation — NOT EXECUTED
results: No ablation result exists; protocol and fail-closed schema package only.
limitations: Oracle query interpretation is not real query understanding.
Oracle fact structure is not automatic extraction.
The experiment is tied to the frozen FM-16 fixture/error classes.
rejected_interpretations: Oracle structural value means deployable structured pipeline.
open_questions: Will the protocol pass final independent enforcement re-review?
Will the user later authorize offline oracle annotation/ablation?

nodes.title: FM-17-pre — Measurement Charter
nodes.summary: Frozen pre-execution measurement charter defining the evidence universe, ternary structural decision states, query strata, metrics, anti-leakage boundaries, and scientifically permitted claims.
nodes.why_read: Open before interpreting any future FM-17-pre result. The charter defines what ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED mean and locks oracle-ceiling claims away from deployment claims.

nodes.title: FM-17-pre — Structural Oracle Ablation Protocol
nodes.summary: Offline bounded structural-oracle ablation protocol over frozen FM-16 run_007 inputs; protocol only, not executed results.
nodes.why_read: Open for the exact planned A0/A1/A2/A3 mechanistic comparison and protected DIRECT/COMPONENT/RELATED/NONANSWER distinctions.
nodes.notes: The protocol background retains an older broad `CE_VS_EMBEDDING = NO_MATERIAL_GAIN` phrasing. For reconciled FM-16 interpretation, the FM-16 closure is controlling: CE ranking is better while global-threshold qualification has no material advantage.

nodes.title: FM-17-pre — Oracle Annotation Guide
nodes.summary: Blinded annotation guide for producing oracle structural labels under preregistered constraints without using gold, hard-negative labels, CE scores, or embedding scores to construct structural fields.
nodes.why_read: Open if annotation is later authorized; it defines how structural oracle labels must be produced without leakage.

nodes.title: FM-17-pre — Frozen run_007 Inputs
nodes.summary: Exact manifest/pointer set defining which FM-16 run_007 queries, facts, candidates, scores, and artifacts form the permitted evidence universe for FM-17-pre.
nodes.why_read: Open to verify that a future ablation uses only the frozen FM-16 evidence universe and does not silently broaden or relabel inputs.

nodes.title: FM-17-pre — STOP Boundary
nodes.summary: Explicit authorization boundary: protocol/schema work is allowed, while annotation, ablation, rescoring, new models, LLM/graph/SLM experiments, runtime changes, architecture promotion, and product changes remain unauthorized.
nodes.why_read: Open before taking any action on FM-17-pre. It records that validator PASS is only an integrity bit and does not authorize annotation or ablation.
